scope: Actual isolated native WebKit and macOS Electron, real file persistence and native XLSX output, synthetic renderer events and injected copy-save failure. New 46-check suite, Electron 48 checks and screenshots use final node-control CSS. Other native suites use the same final JavaScript before only that control-height adjustment. No trusted IME, actual OS notification banner/sound/click or intermediate-motion claim.
diagnostics: Initial Electron copy check caught missing file writes caused by a stale REPL helper binding. All intended code was rewritten using a local transform, read back and verified before passing runs.

Initial cancel-copy test incorrectly required removal of hidden DOM. Existing closePanel contract hides the inspector and clears its editor state; the corrected test verifies hidden state, no unsaved changes and no extra persisted record.
